_comment: Hand-authored. The miniboss room set-up, bank 5 $A663-$A68C. The generator for 20-traced.json subtracts these.

regions.name: MINIBOSS ROOM SET-UP: has this miniboss been beaten?
regions.description: Reached by JMP from the room enemy set-up ($A46B) when the room kind $5D is $40. $5E = the record's sub-id, which is also the miniboss's FLAG number in the array at $04A0; JSR $C0E1 (-> bank 7 $EFE0) tests it. Carry CLEAR = the flag is set (beaten): return and nothing happens, so a beaten miniboss never comes back. Carry SET = still alive: continue at $A66B. RUN: with the flag set $72, $70 and $27 stayed untouched for every sub-id 11-32.

regions.name: Miniboss: choose its type and art, start the boss phase
regions.description: Y := $A682[sub-id] (the 22-byte table at $A68D, read one byte early: a record offset 0-36 into the 3-byte records at $A6A3). The record is [type][stream lo][stream hi]: $72 := the type (the boss the bank 3 boss routine spawns when the phase starts, as for corridor bosses), $28/$29 := the stream (the boss's graphics-load stream, $A6CA-$A6EB) and $27 := $80 (start loading it); $70 := 1 (the boss phase) and $71 := 0 (no other object is exploded and spawning is not stopped, unlike a corridor boss). RUN for all 22 sub-ids with the flag clear: types $1D (11), $58 (12 17 23 25 30), $55 (13), $1E (14 16 19 21), $56 (15), $5A (18), $5B (20), $5D (22), $57 (24 26), $5C (27), $1F (28 29), $5E (31), $47 (32); streams $A6CA ($1D-$1F), $A6CD ($55-$57), $A6D3 ($58), $A6D9 ($47), $A6DF ($5A-$5C), $A6E2 ($5D), $A6E8 ($5E). THE FLAG NUMBERS ARE PARTITIONED across the three kinds of room that use the $04A0 array: items 1-10 and 33-57 (34 rooms), minibosses 11-32 (22 rooms, one each), shops 58-67 (10): no overlap, 67 of the 72 bits. What the types are called was not looked up.
